item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I like the editing you made to the article. It makes it seem much more like a summery of the incident for the archives. However, I think the P.S. should be kept. True, it helps make it seem more serious and official, but keeping it makes the note seem less like propaganda or fanatic babble, and more like poetic, even religious, advice. It is because in conjunction with SCP-507, L.S. appears much more like a major player with knowledge the Foundation doesn't have than just a skilled agent. It plays up the mystery of the incident.
